# Differences between NeoForge 26.3 (the reference) and older NeoForge 26.x that were reviewed and are safe.
# One key per line as LinkCheck prints it after "DIFF".

# BlinkingItemRenderer overrides shouldRender in both forms: with the partial tick (26.3) and without
# (26.1 - 26.2, reached through a method handle). Each form overrides nothing on the versions that lack it
# and is then never called, and so is the 26.3 super call inside it.
method net/minecraft/client/renderer/entity/ItemEntityRenderer.shouldRender(Lnet/minecraft/world/entity/Entity;Lnet/minecraft/client/renderer/culling/Frustum;DDDF)Z
override com/kasper/despawnindicator/client/BlinkingItemRenderer.shouldRender(Lnet/minecraft/world/entity/Entity;Lnet/minecraft/client/renderer/culling/Frustum;DDD)Z
override com/kasper/despawnindicator/client/BlinkingItemRenderer.shouldRender(Lnet/minecraft/world/entity/Entity;Lnet/minecraft/client/renderer/culling/Frustum;DDDF)Z

# GuiCanvas asks Hud.isHidden() whether the HUD is hidden (F1) only when the hideGui option is gone (26.2 on);
# on 26.1, which has no Hud, it reads that option through a method handle.
field net/minecraft/client/gui/Gui.hud:Lnet/minecraft/client/gui/Hud;
method net/minecraft/client/gui/Hud.isHidden()Z
type net/minecraft/client/gui/Hud
